newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -June JGB seen poised to test downside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -June JGB seen poised to test downside.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: drainage of 500 bln yen

*Key June JGB is poised to test the downside due to hedge needs against corporate bonds which have been issued massively in past few weeks. *The recent flattening of the yield curve urged corporations to tap longer-term maturities, hurting the longer-end of cash JGBs. *Near-term support for June at 126.50 was breached on Monday, next support at 125.80.
